συνέρχομαι.g: I come or go with, accompany, assemble
συνέρχομαι.long: I come or go with, accompany; I come together, assemble.
συνέρχομαι.sd: to convene, depart in company with, associate with, or (specially), cohabit (conjugally)
συνέρχομαι.kj: accompany, assemble (with), come (together), come (company, go) with, resort
συνέρχομαι.as:
συν-έρχομαι
[in LXX for הלךְ, בּוֹא, אסף ni., etc. ;]
1. (cl.) to come together, assemble: Mk 3:2014:53, T, WH, txt., Ac 1:62:610:2716:1319:3221:2222:3028:17, I Co 14:26; seq. εἰς, c. acc loc., Ac 5:16; ἐπὶ τ. αὐτό, I Co 11:2014:23; c. dat. pers., Mk 14:53, WH, mg., R (πρὸς αὐτόν, v. Field, Notes, 40), Jo 11:33; ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ, I Co 11:18; ἐνθάδε, Ac 25:17; αὐτοῦ, Mk 6:33, WH, mg. (cf. WH, Intr., 95 ff.); ὅπου, Jo 18:20; c. inf., Lk 5:15; εἰς τ. φαγεῖν, I Co 11:33; εἰς τ. ἧσσον, I Co 11:17, 34; of sexual intercourse (Xen., al.; γυναικί or absol.), Mt 1:18.
2. In later sense (v. exx. in Milligan, Selections, 64, 105), to accompany: c. dat. pers., Lk 23:55, Ac 1:219:3910:23, 4511:12; seq. σύν, Ac 21:16; εἰς, Ac 15:38.†

σύ.der: the personal pronoun of the second person singular;
σύ.as:
σύ,
pron. of 2nd pers.,
thou, you, gen., σοῦ, dat., σοί, acc., σέ, pl., ὑμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς (enclitic in oblique cases sing., except after prep. (BL, §48, 3), though πρὸς σέ occurs in Mt 25:39). Nom. for emphasis or contrast: Jo 1:30, 424:105:33, 39, 44, Ac 4:7, Eph 5:32; so also perhaps σὺ εἶπας, Mt 26:64, al. (M, Pr., 86); before voc., Mt 2:6, Lk 1:76, Jo 17:5, al.; sometimes without emphasis (M, Pr., 85f.), as also in cl., but esp. as rendering of Heb. phrase, e.g. υἱός μου εἶ σύ (בְּנִי־אַתָּה, Ps 2:7), Ac 13:33. The gen. (σοῦ, ὑμῶν) is sometimes placed bef. the noun: Lk 7:48, 12:30, al.; so also the enclitic σοῦ, Mt 9:6; on τί ἐμοὶ κ. σοί, v.s. ἐγώ.

συνάγω.long: I gather together, collect, assemble, receive with hospitality, entertain.
συνάγω.sd: to lead together, i.e. collect or convene; specially, to entertain (hospitably)
συνάγω.kj: + accompany, assemble (selves, together), bestow, come together, gather (selves together, up, together), lead into, resort, take in
συνάγω.as:
συν-άγω
[in LXX chiefly forאסף, also forקבץ, etc. (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 128) ;]
to gather or bring together: of things, Jo 6:12, 13; seq. εἰς, Mt 3:12, al.; ἐκεῖ, Lk 12:18; ποῦ, Lk 12:17; συναγαγὼν πάντα (sc. εἰς ἀργύριον; v. Field, Notes, 68, MM, xxiv), having sold off all: Lk 15:13; of persons, Jo 11:52; esp. of assemblies, Mt 2:4, Jo 11:47, Ac 14:27, al. Pass., to be gathered or come together: Mt 22:41, Mk 2:2, Lk 22:66, al.; seq. ἐπίMk 5:21, Ac 4:27; πρός, Mt 13:2, Mk 4:1, al.; εἰς, Re 19:17; ἐν, Ac 11:26; μετά, Mt 28:12; οὗ, Mt 18:20; ὅπου, Mt 26:57; ἐκεῖ, Jo 18:2, al.
In late writers (v. Kennedy, Sources, 128; cf. De 22:2, al.), to receive hospitably, entertain: Mt 25:35, 38, 43 (cf. ἐπι-συνάγω)

συναγωγή.long: an assembly, congregation, synagogue, either the place or the people gathered together in the place.
συναγωγή.sd: an assemblage of persons; specially, a Jewish "synagogue" (the meeting or the place); by analogy, a Christian church
συναγωγή.as:
συν-αγωγή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for עֵדָה, also for קהל, etc. ;]
prop., a bringing together;
1. of things,
(a)a gathering in of harvest;
(b)a collection of money.
2. Of persons,
(a)a collecting, assembling (Polyb.);
(b)an assembly (MM, xxiv; Deiss., LAE, 101 ff.): Re 2:93:9; esp. of a Jewish religious assembly, a synagogue: Lk 12:11, Ac 9:2, al.; of a Christian assembly, Ja 2:2. By meton., of the building in which the assembly is held, a synagogue: Mt 10:17, Mk 1:21, al. (cf. Cremer, s.v. ἐκκλησία)
SYN.: ἐκκλησία (q.v.)

Συρία.long: Syria, a great Roman imperial province, united with Cilicia.
Συρία.sd: Syria (i.e. Tsyria or Tyre), a region of Asia
Συρία.as:
Συρία, -ας, ή
Syria: Mt 4:24, Lk 2:2, Ac 15:23, 4118:1820:321:3, Ga 1:21.†

συνέχω.g: I press together, confine, compel, am afflicted with
συνέχω.long: (a) I press together, close, (b) I press on every side, confine, (c) I hold fast, (d) I urge, impel, (e) pass: I am afflicted with (sickness).
συνέχω.sd: to hold together, i.e. to compress (the ears, with a crowd or siege) or arrest (a prisoner); figuratively, to compel, perplex, afflict, preoccupy
συνέχω.kj: constrain, hold, keep in, press, lie sick of, stop, be in a strait, straiten, be taken with, throng
συνέχω.as:
συν-έχω
[in LXX for עצר, חבר, etc. ;]
1.to hold together (τ. συνέχον τ. πάντα, Wi 1:7): of closing the ears, Ac 7:57 (τ. στόμα, Is 52:15); to hem in, press on every side: Lk 8:4519:43.
2.to hold fast;
(a) of a prisoner, to hold in charge (Luc.; cf. exx. in Deiss., BS, 160; MM, xxiv): Lk 22:63;
(b)to constrain: II Co 5:14; pass., Lk 12:50, Ac 18:5 (τ. λόγῳ; cf. Field, Notes, 128), Phl 1:23; in pass., of ills, to be seized or afflicted by, suffering from: Mt 4:24, Lk 4:388:37, Ac 28:8.†

συνέδριον.long: a council, tribunal; the Sanhedrin, the meeting place of the Sanhedrin.
συνέδριον.sd: a joint session, i.e. (specially), the Jewish Sanhedrin; by analogy, a subordinate tribunal
συνέδριον.der: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4862 (σύν) and the base of G1476 (ἑδραῖος);
συνέδριον.as:
συνέδριον, -ου, τό
(< σύν + ἕδρα, a seat) [in LXX: Pr 11:1315:22, Je 15:17 (סוֹד), Ps 25 (26):4 (מַת), Pr 22:10 (דִּין) 26:26 (קָהָל); Pr 24:727:2231:23, II Mac 14:5, IV Mac 17:17 * ;]
1.a council (Plat., Xen., al.; LXX; in π., σ. τ. πρεσβυτέρων, Deiss., BS, 156): of a local Jewish tribunal, Mt 10:17, Mk 13:9.
2. The supreme ecclesiastical court of the Jews, the Sanhedrin (i.e. Talmudic סַנְהֵדְרִין = συνέδριον): Mt 5:2226:59, Mk 14:5515:1, Lk 22:66, Ac 5:21, 27, 34, 416:12, 1522:3023:1, 6, 15, 20, 28(WH, R, mg., om.)24:20 of a meeting of the Sanhedrin, Jo 11:47; of the place of meeting, Ac 4:15.†

συμφέρω.long: I bring together, collect; I am profitable to.
συμφέρω.sd: to bear together (contribute), i.e. (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage
συμφέρω.kj: be better for, bring together, be expedient (for), be good, (be) profit(-able for)
συμφέρω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and G5342 (φέρω) (including its alternate);
συμφέρω.as:
συμ-φέρω
[in LXX: Je 33 (26):14 (טוֹב), Pr 19:10 (נָאוֶה), Si 30:19, al. ;]
1. trans. to bring together: c. acc. rei, Ac 19:19.
2. Intrans., and mostly impers., συμφέρει, it is expedient, profitable or an advantage: I Co 6:1210:23, II Co 8:10; c. inf. (M, Pr., 210), Mt 19:10, Jo 18:14; c. dat., seq. ἵνα (Bl., § 69, 5), Mt 5:29, 3018:6, Jo 11:5016:7. Ptcp., ςυμφέρων, profitable: I Co 12:7; pl., Ac 20:20; (οὐ σ. sc. ἐστιν; = οὐ συμφέρει; cf. Thuc., iii, 44, 2), II Co 12:1; as subst., τὸ σ., profit, He 12:10.†

συλλέγω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and G3004 (λέγω) in its original sense;
συλλέγω.as:
συλ-λέγω
[in LXX chiefly for לקט ;]
to bring together, collect, gather up: c. acc. rei, Mt 13:28-30; pass., ib. 40; c. acc., seq. ἀπό, Mt 7:16; id. seq. ἐκ, Mt 13:41, Lk 6:44; seq. εἰς, Mt 13:48.†

σῦκον.as:
σῦκον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for תְּאֵנָה ]
a fig: Mt 7:16, Mk 11:13, Lk 6:44Ja 3:12.†

συνανάκειμαι.sd: to recline in company with (at a meal)
συνανάκειμαι.kj: sit (down, at the table, together) with (at meat)
συνανάκειμαι.as:
**† συν-ανά-κειμαι
[in LXX: III Mac 5:39 * ;]
to recline with or together at table: Mt 14:9, Mk 6:22, Lk 7:4914:15; c. dat. pers., Mt 9:10, Mk 2:15, Lk 14:10.†

συντηρέω.g: I preserve, keep safe, keep in mind
συντηρέω.long: I preserve, keep safe, keep in mind, keep close.
συντηρέω.sd: to keep closely together, i.e. (by implication) to conserve (from ruin); mentally, to remember (and obey)
συντηρέω.as:
συν-τηρέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Ez 18:19 (שׁמר), Da TH 7:28 A (נְטַר), Si 13:12 and freq., To 1:11, II Mac 12:42, al. ;]
"perfective" of τηρέω (v. M, Pr., 113, 116),
1.to preserve, keep safe, keep close: c. acc. pers., Mk 6:20; c. acc. rei, Mt 9:17; ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Lk 2:19 (Arist. and later writers; cf. MM, xxiv).†

συνετός.sd: mentally put (or putting) together, i.e. sagacious
συνετός.as:
συνετός, ή, -όν
(< συνίημι), [in LXX for נָבוֺן, חָכָם, etc. ;]
intelligent, sagacious, understanding: Mt 11:25, Lk 10:21, Ac 13:7, I Co 1:19(LXX).†

συμβούλιον.long: (a) a body of advisers (assessors) in a court, a council, (b) abstr: consultation, counsel, advice; resolution, decree.
συμβούλιον.sd: advisement; specially, a deliberative body, i.e. the provincial assessors or lay-court
συμβούλιον.der: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4825 (σύμβουλος);
συμβούλιον.as:
**† συμβούλιον, -ου, τό
(< σύμβουλος), [in LXX: IV Mac 17:17א * ;]
a word of the Græco-Roman period (of. Lat. consilium, and v. Deiss., BS, 238) = cl. συμβουλία (Arist., Xen.),
1.counsel: σ. λαμβάνειν, Mt 12:1422:1527:1, 728:12; διδόναι, Mk 3:6 (ποιεῖν, Rec.); ποιεῖν, Mk 15:1 (ἑτοιμάζειν, WH, mg.).
2. By meton., a council (IV Mac, l.c.א; συνέδριον, AR): Ac 25:12 (v. MM, xxiv).†

συντρίβω.long: I break by crushing, break in pieces, shatter, crush, bruise.
συντρίβω.sd: to crush completely, i.e. to shatter (literally or figuratively)
συντρίβω.kj: break (in pieces), broken to shivers (+ -hearted), bruise
συντρίβω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G5147 (τρίβος);
συντρίβω.as:
συν-τρίβω
[in LXX chiefly for שׁבר ;]
to shatter, break in pieces: Mt 12:20(LXX), Mk 5:414:3, Jo 19:36(LXX), Re 2:27; of persons and parts of the body, to break, crush, bruise: Lk 9:39; fig., Ro 16:20.†

συνίημι.sd: to put together, i.e. (mentally) to comprehend; by implication, to act piously
συνίημι.as:
συν-ίημι and συνίω (v. Bl., § 23, 7),
[in LXX chiefly for בּין hi., שׂכל hi. ;]
1.to bring or set together.
2. Metaph., to perceive, understand: Mt 13:13-15(LXX), 1915:10, Mk 4:9(WH, mg.), 127:148:17, 21Lk 8:10, Ac 7:2528:26, 27, Ro 15:21(LXX), II Co 10:12; c. acc. rei, Mt 13:23, 51, Lk 2:5018:3424:45; seq. ὅτι, Mt 16:1217:13; seq. quæst. indir., Eph 5:17; ἐπὶ τ. ἄρτοις, Mk 6:52; as subst., συνίων (ὁ σ., WH, mg.), a man of understanding, i.e. in moral and religious sense, Ro 3:11(LXX).†

συμπνίγω.long: I choke utterly, as weeds do plants; I crowd upon.
συμπνίγω.sd: to strangle completely, i.e. (literally) to drown, or (figuratively) to crowd
συμπνίγω.as:
* συν-πνίγω (Rec. συμπ-),
to choke: of thronging by a crowd, Lk 8:42. Fig., of seed, τ. λόγον, Mt 13:22, Mk 4:7, 19, Lk 8:14.†

συναυξάνομαι.as:
** συν-αυξάνω
[in LXX: II Mac 4:4, IV Mac 13:27 * ;]
to cause to increase or grow together. Pass., to grow together: Mt 13:30 (Xen., al.).†

συντέλεια.sd: entire completion, i.e. consummation (of a dispensation)
συντέλεια.as:
συντέλεια, -ας, ἡ
(< συντελέω), [in LXX chiefly for כָּלָה and (in Da) for קֵץ ;]
1. in cl., a joint payment or contribution for public service; hence, generally, joint action (Plat.).
2. In late writers (Polyb., al.), consummation, completion: σ. τ. αἰῶνος, -ων (cf. Da LXX TH 12:13, al.), Mt 13:39, 40, 4924:328:20, He 9:26.†

συλλαλέω.as:
συν-λαλέω
(Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX for דּברpi.,שִׂיחַ;]
to talk with or together: (c. dat. pers., Mk 9:4, Lk 9:3022:4; seq. μετά, c. gen., Mt 17:3, Ac 25:12; . πρός, c. acc., Lk 4:36.†

συστρέφω.sd: to twist together, i.e. collect (a bundle, a crowd)
συστρέφω.as:
συ-στρέφω
[in LXX chiefly for קשׁר ;]
1.to twist together: c. acc. rei, Ac 28:3.
2. Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together: Mt 17:22 (WH, R, mg.).†

συμφωνέω.long: I agree with, harmonize with, agree together.
συμφωνέω.sd: to be harmonious, i.e. (figuratively) to accord (be suitable, concur) or stipulate (by compact)
συμφωνέω.as:
συμ-φωνέω, -ῶ,
[in LXX: Ge 14:3 (חבר) II Ki 12:8 (9) (אוֺת ni.), Is 7:2 (נוּחַ), IV Mac 14:6 * ;]
prop., to agree in sound, be in harmony (Plat., Arist.). Metaph.,
(a)to agree with, agree together: Lk 5:36; c. dat. rei, Ac 15:15; seq. περί, Mt 18:19; pass., c. dat. pers., συνεφωνήθη ὑμῖν, Ac 5:9;
(b)to agree as to a price (Polyb., Diod.): c. dat. pers., gen. pret., Mt 20:13; seq. μετά . . . ἐκ, ib. 2.†

συναίρω.g: I make a reckoning, settle accounts
συναίρω.long: I compare (settle) accounts, make a reckoning.
συναίρω.sd: to make up together, i.e. (figuratively) to compute (an account)
συναίρω.as:
συν-αίρω
[in LXX: Ex 23:5 (עזב) * ;]
to take up together: σ. λόγον (of which there are several exx. in π.; v. Deiss., LAE, 118 f.; MM, i, xxiv; M, Pr., 160), to settle accounts, Mt 18:23, 24; seq. μετά, C. gen. pers., Mt 25:19.†

σύνδουλος.long: a fellow slave, fellow servant; of Christians: a fellow worker, colleague.
σύνδουλος.sd: a co-slave, i.e. servitor or ministrant of the same master (human or divine)
σύνδουλος.as:
σύν-δουλος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Es 4:7, 9, 17, 235:3, 66:6, 13 (כְּנָת) * ;]
a fellow-servant: Mt 18:28-3324:49; of servants of the same divine Lord, Col 1:74:7, Re 6:11; so of angels, Re 19:1022:9.†

συζεύγνυμι.long: I yoke together, unite (as man and wife).
συζεύγνυμι.sd: to yoke together, i.e. (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage)
συζεύγνυμι.der: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G2201 (ζεῦγος);
συζεύγνυμι.as:
συν-ζεύγνυμι
(Rec. συζ-), [in LXX: Ez 1:11, 23 (חבר) * ;]
to yoke to­gether: metaph., of union in wedlock, Mt 19:6, Mk 10:9.†

συντάσσω.long: I arrange with, direct, appoint, prescribe, ordain.
συντάσσω.sd: to arrange jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to direct
συντάσσω.as:
συν-τάσσω
[in LXX chiefly for צוה pi. ;]
to prescribe, ordain, arrange: c. dat. pers, Mt 21:626:1927:10(LXX).†

συκῆ.as:
συκῆ (contr. fr. συκέα), -ῆς, ἡ
(< σῦκον), [in LXX for תְּאֵנָה ;]
a fig-tree: Mt 21:19-2124:32, Mk 11:13, 20, 2113:28, Lk 13:6, 721:29, Jo 1:49, 51, Ja 3:12, Re 6:13.†

συνθλάομαι.long: I break, break in pieces, crush, shatter.
συνθλάομαι.as:
συν-θλάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for מחץ etc. ;]
to crush together, crush: Mt 21:44 ([WH], R, mg., om.), Lk 20:18.†

σύν.sd: with or together (but much closer than G3326 (μετά) or G3844 (παρά)), i.e. by association, companionship, process, resemblance, possession, instrumentality, addition, etc.
σύν.as:
σύν (old Att. ξύν),
prep. c. dat.,
expressing association, fellowship and inclusion. It gradually gave way to μετά, c. gen. (cf. LS, s.v.; Bl., § 41, 3), and is therefore comparatively infrequent in NT, being rare in Mt4, Mk6, Jo3, and elsewhere (exx. Ja 1:11, II Pe 1:18) only in Lk (Gosp. and Ac) and Paul. With, together with: of companionship and association, Lk 2:13, Jo 21:3, Ac 10:23, al.; εἶναι σύν τινι, Lk 7:12, Ac 4:13, Phl 1:23, al.; of partisanship, Ac 4:13; οἱ σύν τινι (ὄντες), of attendants, companions or colleagues, Mk 2:26, Lk 5:9, Ac 5:17, al.; of assistance, ἡ χάρις τ. θεοῦ σὺν ἐμοί, I Co 15:10; of two or more things together, almost = καί, Lk 23:11, Ac 3:410:214:523:15, Eph 3:18; σὺν Χριστῷ ζῆν, II Co 13:4; besides (FlJ, LXX), σὺν πᾶσι τούτοις, Lk 24:21.
In composition: with (συνχαίρω), together (συνωδίνω), altogether (συντελέω).

συμβουλεύω.long: I give advice, exhort; mid: I take counsel together, consult.
συμβουλεύω.sd: to give (or take) advice jointly, i.e. recommend, deliberate or determine
συμβουλεύω.as:
συμ-βουλεύω
[in LXX chiefly for יעץ ;]
1.to advise, counsel: c. dat. pers., Jo 18:14; id. seq. inf., Re 3:18.
2. Mid., to take counsel, consult: seq. ἵνα, Mt 26:4 ("reciprocal middle," v. M, Pr., 157); c. inf., Ac 9:23.†

συλλαμβάνω.long: I seize, apprehend, assist, conceive, become pregnant.
συλλαμβάνω.sd: to clasp, i.e. seize (arrest, capture); specially, to conceive (literally or figuratively); by implication, to aid
συλλαμβάνω.as:
συλ-λαμβάνω
[in LXX for תּפשׂ, הרה, etc. ;]
1. c. acc., to bring together, collect.
2.to seize, take: c. acc. pers., as a prisoner, Mt 26:55, Mk 14:48, Lk 22:54, Jo 18:12, Ac 1:1612:3; pass., Ac 23:27; mid., in sense of act., Ac 26:21; σ. ἄγραν ἰχθύων, Lk 5:9.
3. C. dat. pers., to take part with, assist, succour; mid., in same sense: Lk 5:7, Phl 4:3.
4. Of a woman, to conceive: absol., Lk 1:24; seq. ἐν γαστρί, Lk 1:31; c. acc., Lk 1:36; ib. seq. ἐν τ. κοιλίᾳ, Lk 2:21; metaph., of lust producing sin, Ja 1:15.†

συσταυρόομαι.sd: to impale in company with (literally or figuratively)
συσταυρόομαι.as:
* συν-σταυρόω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ,
to crucify together with: pass., c. dat., Jo 19:32; id. seq. σύν, Mt 27:44, Mk 15:32. Metaph., of the mystical death of the Christian with Christ: Ro 6:6, Ga 2:20 (Eccl.).†

συζητέω.sd: to investigate jointly, i.e. discuss, controvert, cavil
συζητέω.as:
συν-ζητέω
(Rec. συζ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Ne 2:4 AB1 (בּקשׁ pi.) * ;]
1.to search or examine together (Plat.).
2. In NT (and π., v. MM, xxiii; also in MGr., v. Kennedy, Sources, 155), to discuss, dispute: Mk 1:2712:28, Lk 24:15; seq. quæst. indir., Mk 9:10; c. dat. pers., Mk 8:11Ac 6:9; seq. πρός, c. acc pers., Mk 9:14, 16, Ac 9:29; id. seq. quæst. indir., Lk 22:23.†

συλλυπέομαι.long: I am moved to grief by sympathy.
συλλυπέομαι.sd: to afflict jointly, i.e. (passive) sorrow at (on account of) someone
συλλυπέομαι.as:
συν-λυπέω
(Rec. συλλ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Ps 68 (69):20, Is 51:19 (נוּד) * ;]
to make to grieve with (Arist.). Pass., to be moved to grief by sympathy: seq. ἐπί, c. dat., Mk 3:5.†

συνθλίβω.long: I press on all sides, crowd upon.
συνθλίβω.sd: to compress, i.e. crowd on all sides
συνθλίβω.as:
συν-θλίβω
[in LXX: Ec 12:6א A (רצץ), Si 34 (31):14, I Mac 15:14 A * ;]
to press together, press on all sides: Mk 5:24, 31.†

συνακολουθέω.as:
** συν-ακολουθέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: II Mac 2:4, 6 * ;]
to follow along with, accompany: c. dat. pers., Mk 14:51, Lk 23:49; seq. μετά, c. gen. pers., Mk 5:37.†

συγγενής.long: akin to, related; subst: fellow countryman, kinsman.
συγγενής.sd: a relative (by blood); by extension, a fellow countryman
συγγενής.as:
σνγγενής, -ές (dat. pl., -εῦσιν, Mk 6:4, Lk 2:44, as though from -εύς, v. Swete, Mk., l.c.; Bl., § 8, 6; cf. I Mac 10:89 Aא2 *;)
(< σύν, γένος), [in LXX for דּוֹד, דּוֹדָה, מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
1.congenital, natural, innate.
2.akin to; as subst., a kinsman: Mk 6:4, Lk 1:582:4414:1221:16, Jo 18:26, Ac 10:24; of tribal kinship, Ro 9:316:7, 11, 21.†
SYN.: ἴδιος, οἰκεῖος (q.v.)

συντρέχω.sd: to rush together (hastily assemble) or headlong (figuratively)
συντρέχω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and G5143 (τρέχω) (including its alternate);
συντρέχω.as:
συν-τρέχω
[in LXX: Ps 49 (50):18 (עִםרָצָה), II Mac 2, Jdt 4 * ;]
to run together or with: seq. ἐκεῖ, Mk 6:33; πρόσ, c. acc., Ac 3:11; metaph., I Pe 4:4.†

συμπόσιον.sd: a drinking-party ("symposium"), i.e. (by extension) a room of guests
συμπόσιον.der: neuter of a derivative of the alternate of G4844 (συμπίνω);
συμπόσιον.as:
συμπόσιον, -ου, τό
(< συμπίνω), [in LXX: Es 7:7 (מִשְׁתֶּהיַיִן) 4:17, I Mac 16:16, II Mac 2:27, III Mac 4:165:366:33; σ. οἴνου, Sir 34 (31):3135 (32):5, 49:1 * ;]
1.a drinking party
2. By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; v. M, Pr., 97), in parties or companies: Mk 6:39.†

Συροφοινίκισσα.long: Syrophoenician, i.e. Phoenician (of Syria, in contrast to Carthage and its territory in North Africa).
Συροφοινίκισσα.sd: a Syro-phœnician woman, i.e. a female native of Phœnicia in Syria
Συροφοινίκισσα.der: feminine of a compound of G4948 (Σύρος) and the same as G5403 (Φοινίκη);
Συροφοινίκισσα.as:
Συροφοινίκισσα (Rec. -φοίνισσα), -ης, ἡ
a Syropænician woman: Mk 7:26, WH, txt., RV (cf. ἡ Φοινίκη Συρία, Diod., 19, 93).†

συσπαράσσω.g: I throw violently on the ground
συσπαράσσω.long: I throw violently on the ground.
συσπαράσσω.sd: to rend completely, i.e. (by analogy) to convulse violently
συσπαράσσω.as:
*† συ-σπαράσσω
to convulse completely: c. acc. pers., Mk 9:20, Lk 9:42 (cf. σπαράσσω).†

συμπορεύομαι.long: I journey together with; I come together, assemble.
συμπορεύομαι.sd: to journey together; by implication, to assemble
συμπορεύομαι.as:
συν-πορεύομαι
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX chiefly for הלךְ ;]
1.to journey together (Plat., al.): c. dat. pers., Lk 7:1114:2524:15.
2.to come together: Mk 10:1 (Plut., al.).†

συμβαίνω.sd: to walk (figuratively, transpire) together, i.e. concur (take place)
συμβαίνω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G939 (βάσις);
συμβαίνω.as:
συμ-βαίνω
[in LXX for עשׂה, קרא, קרה, etc. ;]
1.to stand with the feet together.
2.to come together, come to terms.
3. Of events, to come to pass, happen: c. dat. pers., Mk 10:32, Ac 3:1020:19, I Co 10:11, I Pe 4:12, II Pe 2:22; absol., τὰ συμβεβηκότα, Lk 24:14 (cf. I Mac 4:26); c. acc. et inf., Ac 21:35.†

σύνεσις.long: a putting together in the mind, hence: understanding, practical discernment, intellect.
σύνεσις.sd: a mental putting together, i.e. intelligence or (concretely) the intellect
σύνεσις.as:
σύνεσις, -εως, ἡ
(< συνίημι), [in LXX for בִּינָה and cogn. forms, מַשְׂכִּית, דַּעַת, חׇכְמָה, etc. ;]
1.a running or flowing together (Hom.).
2. (a) understanding: Lk 2:47, I Co 1:19(LXX), Eph 3:4, Col 1:92:2, II Ti 2:7
(b)the understanding, the mind or intelligence: Mk 12:33.†
SYN.: v.s. σοφία

συντελέω.long: I bring to an end, fulfill, accomplish.
συντελέω.sd: to complete entirely; generally, to execute (literally or figuratively)
συντελέω.as:
συν-τελέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for כּלה pi., also for עשׂה, תּמם, etc. ;]
"perfective" of τελέω (cf. M, Pr., 118),
1.to complete, finish, bring to an end: Lk 4:13; pass., ib. 2, Jo 2:3, WH, mg., Ac 21:27.
2.to effect, accomplish, bring to fulfilment (cf. MM, xxiv): Mk 13:4, Ro 9:28, He 8:8.†

συναποθνῄσκω.sd: to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively), similarly to
συναποθνῄσκω.as:
** συν-απο-θνήσκω
[in LXX: Si 19:10 * ;]
to die with or together: Mk 14:31, II Co 7:3 (v. Meyer, in l.), II Ti 2:11.†

σύσσημον.sd: a sign in common, i.e. preconcerted signal
σύσσημον.der: neuter of a compound of G4862 (σύν) and the base of G4591 (σημαίνω);
σύσσημον.as:
† σύσ-σημον (T, συν-), -ου, τό
(< σῆμα), [in LXX: Jg 20:38, 40 (מַשְׂאֵת), Is 5:2649:2262:10 (נֵס) * ;]
a fixed sign or signal: Mk 14:44. (Strab., Plut., al.; condemned by Atticists, v. Rutherford, NPhr., 492 f.) †

συγκάθημαι.sd: to seat oneself in company with
συγκάθημαι.as:
συν-κάθημαι
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Ps 100 (101):6 (ישׁב) * ;]
to sit together or with: c. dat., Ac 26:30; seq. μετά, c. gen., Mk 14:54.†

συγκαλέω.as:
συν-καλέω
(Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, [in LXX for קרא ;]
to call together: c. acc., Mk 15:16, Lk 15:6, 9 (v.l. -εῖται, v. B1., § 55, 1), Ac 5:21. Mid., to call together to oneself : Lk 9:1 (and v.l. in 15:6, 9 v. supr.) 23:13, Ac 10:2428:17.†

συναναβαίνω.as:
συν-ανα-βαίνω
[in LXX for עלה ;]
to go up with: c. dat. pers., seq. εἰς, c. acc. loc., Mk 15:41, Ac 13:31.†

συντόμως.der: adverb from a derivative of G4932 (συντέμνω);
συντόμως.as:
συν-τόμως,
adv.
(< συντέμνω) [in LXX: Pr 13:23 (בְּלֹאמׅשְׁפָּט) 23:28, III Mac 5:25 * ;]
concisely, briefly: Ac 24:4 (for a similar ex., v. MM, xxiv).†

συνεργέω.sd: to be a fellow-worker, i.e. co-operate
συνεργέω.as:
** συνεργέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Es 7:2, I Mac 12:1 * ;]
1. prop., to work together (with): absol., Mk 16:[20], I Co 16:16, II Co 6:1; c. dat., Ja 2:22; dat. commod., Ro 8:28, T, R, txt. (but v. infr.).
2. In Hellenistic writers (M, Pr., 65), trans., to cause to work together (cf. ICC, in l.): c. acc. rei, Ro 8:28 [WH] R, mg. (but v. supr.).†

συγγενίς.as:
*† συγγενίς, -ίδος, ἡ,
late fem. form of σνγγενής, q.v.,
a kinswoman: Lk 1:36.†

συγχαίρω.as:
συν-χαίρω
(Rec. συγ-), [in LXX: Ge 21:6 (צחק), III Mac 1:8 R * ;]
1.to rejoice with: c. dat pers., Lk 1:5815:6, 9, Phl 2:17, 18, EV; c. dat. rei, I Co 12:2613:6.
2.to congratulate (Æschin., Polyb., al.): Phl, l.c. (Lft., in l.; cf. MM, xxiv).†

συγγένεια.as:
συγγένεια, -ας, ἡ
(< συγγενής), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
1.kinship.
2. By meton., kinsfolk, kindred: Lk 1:61, Ac 7:3, 14 †

συμβάλλω.g: I ponder, encounter, confer or dispute with
συμβάλλω.long: properly: I throw together, hence: I ponder, come up with, encounter, with or without hostile intent; I dispute with; mid: I confer, consult with, contribute.
συμβάλλω.sd: to combine, i.e. (in speaking) to converse, consult, dispute, (mentally) to consider, (by implication) to aid, (personally) to join, attack
συμβάλλω.kj: confer, encounter, help, make, meet with, ponder
συμβάλλω.as:
συν-βάλλω
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: II Ch 25:19 (גּרה hith.), Is 46:6 (זוּל), Je 50 (43):3 (סוּת hi.), Wi 5:8, al. ;]
to throw together, hence,
(a) of speech (seq. λόγους, Eur., al.), to discuss, confer (sc. λόγους): c. dat. pers., Lk 11:53, WH, mg., Ac 17:18; seq. πρὸς ἀλλήλους, Ac 4:15;
(b)to reflect, consider, ponder: ἐν τ. καρδίᾳ, Lk 2:19;
(c)to meet with, fall in with: Ac 20:14; in hostile sense, εἰς πόλεμον, c. dat. (εἰς μάχην, Polyb.), Lk 14:31;
(d) mid., to contribute (Polyb., al.; cf. MM, xxiv): Ac 18:27.†

Συμεών.sd: Symeon (i.e. Shimon), the name of five Israelites
Συμεών.as:
Συμεών, ὁ indecl., (Heb. שִׁמְעוֹן),
Simeon (so always AV; RV in Lk 2:25, 34 only), Symeon, a Heb. name for which the Gk. Σίμων, q.v., was also used;
1. the son of Jacob (Ge 29:33): Re 7:7.
2. An ancestor of our Lord: Lk 3:30
3. An aged worshipper in the Temple: Lk 2:25, 34.
4. One surnamed Niger: Ac 13:1.
5. The apostle Peter: Ac 15:14, II Pe 1:1 (R, txt., WH, txt., Σίμων).†

συνοδία.g: a company traveling together, a caravan
συνοδία.long: a company traveling together, a caravan.
συνοδία.sd: companionship on a journey, i.e. (by implication), a caravan
συνοδία.der: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G3598 (ὁδός) ("synod");
συνοδία.as:
συνοδία, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX: Ne 7:5, 64 (יחשׂ) * ;]
1.a journey in company (Plut., al.).
2. By meton., a company of travellers, a caravan: Lk 2:44.†

συκοφαντέω.sd: to be a fig-informer (reporter of the law forbidding the exportation of figs from Greece), "sycophant", i.e. (genitive and by extension) to defraud (exact unlawfully, extort)
συκοφαντέω.kj: accuse falsely, take by false accusation
συκοφαντέω.der: from a compound of G4810 (σῦκον) and a derivative of G5316 (φαίνω);
συκοφαντέω.as:
συκοφαντέω, -ῶ
(< σῦκον, φαίνω), [in LXX: Ge 43:18 (גּלל hithpo.), Le 19:11 (שׁקר pi.), Jb 35:9, Ps 118 (119):122, Pr 14:3122:1628:3, Ec 4:1 (עשׁק) *;]
to act theσυκοφάντης (on conjectures as to the origin of the term, v. LS, s.v.), to accuse falsely (Aristoph., Xen., al.): Lk 3:14 (R, mg.) 19:8 (RV, exact wrongfully; but cf. Hatch, Essays, 89 ff., v. also Field, Notes, 56 f.; MM, xxiv).†

Σύρος.sd: a Syran (i.e. probably Tyrian), a native of Syria
Σύρος.as:
Σύρος, -ου, ὁ, fem. Σύρα,
a Syrian: Lk 4:27, Mk 7:26, WH, mg.†

συγκλείω.long: I enclose, shut in, make subject to.
συγκλείω.sd: to shut together, i.e. include or (figuratively) embrace in a common subjection to
συγκλείω.as:
συν-κλείω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for סגר;]
to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides: of a catch of fish, Lk 5:6; metaph. (Ps 30 (31):9, al.), Ro 11:32, Ga 3:22, 23.†

συμπίπτω.long: I fall, fall under (as under condemnation), fall prostrate.
συμπίπτω.der: probably akin to G4072 (πέτομαι) through the idea of alighting;
συμπίπτω.as:
πίπτω,
[in LXX chiefly for נפל;]
to fall;
1. of descent, to fall, fall down or from: seq. ἐπί, c. acc. loc., Mt 10:29, al.; εἰς, Mt 15:14, al.; ἐς μέσῳ, c. gen., Lk 8:7; παρὰ τ. ὁδόν, Mt 13:4, Mk 4:4, Lk 8:5; seq. ἀπό, Mt 15:27, al.; ἐκ, Mk 13:25, Lk 10:18, Re 8:109:1. Metaph.: ὁ ἥλιος, seq. ἐπί, Re 7:16; ἀχλὺς κ. σκότος, Ac 13:11; ὁ κλῆρος, Ac 1:26; ὑπὸ κρίσιν, Ja 5:12.
2. Of prostration,
(a) of persons, to fall prostrate, prostrate oneself: χαμαί, Jo 18:6; seq. ἐπί, c. acc., Mt 17:6, Ac 9:4; id. c. gen., Mk 9:20; πρὸς τ. πόδας, Ac 5:10, Re 1:17; πεσὼν ἐξέψυξε, Ac 5:5; of supplication, homage or worship: πρὸς (παρὰ, ἐπὶ) τ. πὸδας, Mk 5:22, Lk 8:41, Ac 10:25, al.; π. καὶ προσκυνεῖν, Re 5:1419:4; ptcp. c. προσκυνεῖν, Mt 2:11, al.; ἐνώπιον, Re 4:105:8; ἐπὶ πρόσωπον, Mt 26:39, al.;
(b) of things, to fall, fall down: Mt 21:44, Lk 23:30; of falling to ruin and destruction, Mt 7:25, Ac 15:16, He 11:30; ἔπεσε (timeless aorist; M, Pr.,134), Re 18:2. Metaph.: Ro 11:11; πόθεν πέπτωκας, Re 2:5; opp. to ἑστάναι, I Co 10:12; to στήκειν, Ro 14:4; of virtues, I Co 13:8; of precepts, Lk 16:17. (Cf. ἀνα-, ἀντι-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, κατα-, παρα-, περι-, προσ-, συν-πίπτω.)

σύνειμι.long: I am with, come together with.
σύνειμι.sd: to be in company with, i.e. present at the time
σύνειμι.der: from G4862 (σύν) and G1510 (εἰμί) (including its various inflections);

συμφύομαι.g: I grow at the same time
συμφύομαι.long: I grow at the same time.
συμφύομαι.as:
** συν-φύω
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Wi 13:13 * ;]
to cause to grow together. Pass., to grow together or with (Plat. al.): Lk 8:7.†

συντυγχάνω.long: I meet with, come to, fall in with.
συντυγχάνω.sd: to chance together, i.e. meet with (reach)
συντυγχάνω.as:
** συν-τυγχάνω
[in LXX: II Mac 8:14 * ;]
to meet with, fall in with: c. dat. pers., Lk 8:19.†

συμπληρόω.long: I fill completely; pass: I am completed.
συμπληρόω.sd: to implenish completely, i.e. (of space) to swamp (a boat), or (of time) to accomplish (passive, be complete)
συμπληρόω.as:
συν-πληρόω
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: Je 25:12 (מָלֵא) * ;]
1.to fill up completely (Thuc., of manning ships): of a ship filling with water, and by meton., of those on board, Lk 8:23.
2.to complete, fulfil: of time (Je, l.c., and v. MM, xxiv), Lk 9:51, Ac 2:1 (on the "durative inf.," v. M, Pr., 233).†

συναρπάζω.as:
συν-αρπάζω
[in LXX: Pr 6:25 (לקח), II Mac 3:274:41, IV Mac 5:4 * ;]
"perfective " of ἁοπάζω (v. M, Pr., 113),
(a)to seize and carry away (so most commonly) : Ac 27:15;
(b)to seize and hold: Lk 8:29, Ac 6:1219:29.†

συνίστημι.g: I commend, prove, am composed of, cohere
συνίστημι.long: I place together, commend, prove, exhibit; instrans: I stand with; I am composed of, cohere.
συνίστημι.sd: to set together, i.e. (by implication) to introduce (favorably), or (figuratively) to exhibit; intransitively, to stand near, or (figuratively) to constitute
συνίστημι.der: from G4862 (σύν) and G2476 (ἵστημι) (including its collateral forms);
συνίστημι.as:
συν-ίστημι
[in LXX for צוה pi., קהל ni., etc.; I Mac 12:43, II Mac 4:24, III Mac 1:19 (and freq. in these books) ;]
1. trans.,
(a)to commend, recommend: c. acc. pers., II Co 3:16:410:12, 18; id. c. dat., Ro 16:1 (as freq. at the beginning of a letter; Deiss., LAE, 226), II Co 5:12; seq. πρός, II Co 4:2; pass., seq. ὑπό, II Co 12:11;
(b)to show, prove, establish: c. acc., Ro 3:55:8, II Co 6:4; dupl. acc., Ga 2:13; acc. et inf., II Co 7:11
2. Intrans., pf., συνέστηκα (as also 2 aor. and plpf.);
(a)to stand with or near: Lk 9:32;
(b)to be composed of, consist, cohere: Col 1:17 (v. Lft., in l.), II Pe 3:5.†

συναντάω.long: I meet, encounter, fall in with.
συναντάω.sd: to meet with; figuratively, to occur
συναντάω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G473 (ἀντί);
συναντάω.as:
συν-αντάω, -ῶ
[in LXX for פּגע,פּגשׁ,קרא,קרה, etc. ;]
to meet with: c. dat. pers., Lk 9:18, 3722:10, Ac 10:25, He 7:1, 10. Metaph., of events, to happen, befall (Diog. L., Plut., al.): Ac 20:22.†

συγκυρία.sd: from the base of G2962 (κύριος)); concurrence, i.e. accident
συγκυρία.der: from a comparative of G4862 (σύν) and (to light or happen;
συγκυρία.as:
** συγκυρία, -ας, ἡ
(< συγκυρέω, to happen), [in Sm.: I Ki 6:9 (מִקְרֶה) * ;] (more freq. in late writers, συγκύρησις, -ημα),
chance, coincidence: κατὰ σ. (v. MM, xxiii), Lk 10:31 (Hippocr., Eccl.).†

συναντιλαμβάνομαι.long: I lend a hand along with, take interest in (a thing) along with (others), assist jointly to perform some task, cooperate with, take my share in, help, aid.
συναντιλαμβάνομαι.sd: to take hold of opposite together, i.e. co-operate (assist)
συναντιλαμβάνομαι.as:
† συν-αντι-λαμβάνομαι
[in LXX: Ge 30:8 R (†), Ex 18:22, Nu 11:17 (נשׂא), Ps 88 (89):21 (כּוּן ni.) * ;]
to take hold with at the side for assistance; hence, to take a share in, help in bearing, and generally, help (with various constructions, v. LXX, ll. c., Deiss., LAE, 83 f.): c. dat., Lk 10:40, Ro 8:26.†

συνευδοκέω.g: I consent, agree, am of one mind with
συνευδοκέω.long: I consent, agree, am of one mind with, am willing.
συνευδοκέω.sd: to think well of in common, i.e. assent to, feel gratified with
συνευδοκέω.kj: allow, assent, be pleased, have pleasure
συνευδοκέω.as:
** συν-ευ-δοκέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Mac 1:57, 4:28א1, II Mac 11:24, 35 * ;]
to join in approving, consent, agree to or with: absol., Ac 22:20; c. dat. pers., Ro 1:32; c. dat. rei, Lk 11:48, Ac 8:1; c. inf., I Co 7:12, 13 (chiefly in late writers).†

συγκαλύπτω.g: I conceal closely, cover up wholly
συγκαλύπτω.long: I conceal closely, cover up wholly.
συγκαλύπτω.as:
συν-καλύπτω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for כּסה pi. ;]
to veil or cover completely: c. acc., pass., Lk 12:2.†

συγκύπτω.long: I am bowed together, bent double.
συγκύπτω.sd: to stoop altogether, i.e. be completely overcome by
συγκύπτω.as:
συν-κύπτω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Jb 9:27 (עזב), Si 12:1119:26 * ;]
1.to bend forwards (Arist., al.).
2.to be bowed down: Lk 13:11.†

συνεσθίω.sd: to take food in company with
συνεσθίω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and G2068 (ἐσθίω) (including its alternate);
συνεσθίω.as:
συν-εσθίω
[in LXX: Ge 43:32, Ex 18:12 (אכל), II Ki 12:17 (בּרה), Ps 100 (101):5 * ;]
to eat with one: c. dat. pers., Lk 15:2, Ac 10:4111:3, I Co 5:11; seq. μετά, c. gen. pers., Ga 2:12.†

συμφωνία.sd: unison of sound ("symphony"), i.e. a concert of instruments (harmonious note)
συμφωνία.as:
συμφωνία, -ας, ἡ
(< σύμφωνος), [in LXX: Da LXX TH 3:5, 15, TH ib. 7, 10 (סוּמפֹּנְיָה) IV Mac 14:3 A * ;]
1.symphony, music: Lk 15:25
2.a musical instrument (Polyb., al.; Da, ll. c.; v MM, xxiv).†

συκάμινος.long: a sycamore tree, black mulberry tree.
συκάμινος.der: of Hebrew origin (H08256) in imitation of G4809 (συκομωραία);
συκάμινος.as:
συκάμινος, -ου, ἡ
[in LXX for שִׁקְמָה (pl.) ;]
the mulberry tree
(Lat. morus; cf. μόρον, I Mac 6:34 *),
the sycamine: Lk 17:6. (In LXX, σ. appears to represent the συκόμορος (v.s. συκομορέα), but St. Luke distinguishes between the two; v. ICC, in l.; DB, iv, 634.) †

συκομορέα.as:
*† συκο-μορέα (Rec. -μωραία, L, -μωρέα), -ας, ἡ, more commonly (so Aq., Sm., Ps 77 (78):47, Is 9:10 (9)) συκόμορος
(< σῦκον + μόρον, the black mulberry),
a fig-mulberry, a sycamore: Lk 19:4 (cf. συκάμινος).†

συλλογίζομαι.long: I reason, reckon with myself, consider.
συλλογίζομαι.sd: to reckon together (with oneself), i.e. deliberate
συλλογίζομαι.as:
συλ-λογίζομαι
[in LXX chiefly for חשׁב pi. ;]
1.to compute.
2.to reason: Lk 20:5.†

συνοχή.as:
συν-οχή, -ῆς, ή
(< συνέχω), [in LXX: Jg 2:3 (?), Jb 30:3 (שׁוֺאָה), ib. 38:28 A; Mi 5:1 (4:14), Je 52:5 (מָצוֹר) * ;]
1.a holding or being held together.
2.a narrow place (Hom., al.). Metaph., straits, distress: Lk 21:25; καρδίας, II Co 2:4.†

συντίθεμαι.long: mid. and pass: I make a compact (agreement) with (together), covenant with, agree.
συντίθεμαι.sd: to place jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to consent (bargain, stipulate), concur
συντίθεμαι.der: middle voice from G4862 (σύν) and G5087 (τίθημι);
συντίθεμαι.as:
συν-τίθημι
[in LXX: I Ki 22:13 (קשׁר), etc. ;]
to place or put together, in various senses. Mid.,
(a)to observe, perceive;
(b)to determine, agree, covenant: c. inf., Lk 22:5; seq. τοῦ, c. inf., Ac 23:20; seq. ἵνα, Jo 9:22.†

συγκαθίζω.g: I cause to sit down with, sit down together
συγκαθίζω.long: I cause to sit down with, sit down together.
συγκαθίζω.sd: to give (or take) a seat in company with
συγκαθίζω.as:
περι-καθ-ίζω,
[in LXX for חנה, לחם ni., etc.;]
1.to invest, besiege (Diod., IV Ki 6:24, I Mac 11:61, al.).
2.to sit around: Lk 22:55, L, txt.†

συμπαραγίνομαι.long: I come together with, stand by one, help.
συμπαραγίνομαι.sd: to be present together, i.e. to convene; by implication, to appear in aid
συμπαραγίνομαι.as:
συν-παρα-γίνομαι
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Ps 82 (83):8 (לוה ni.) * ;]
1.to come up or be present together: seq. ἐπί, Lk 23:48.
2.to come up to assist (Thuc., al.; II Ti 4:16, Rec.).†

συγκατατίθεμαι.g: I give a vote with, assent to
συγκατατίθεμαι.long: I give a vote with, assent to.
συγκατατίθεμαι.sd: to deposit (one's vote or opinion) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to accord with
συγκατατίθεμαι.as:
συν-κατα-τίθημι
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Ex 23:1 (יָדשִׁית), ib. 32 (כּרת), Da TH Su 1:20 * ;]
to deposit together. Mid., to deposit one's vote with, hence, to agree with, assent to: c. dat., Lk 23:51.†

Συχάρ.sd: Sychar (i.e. Shekar), a place in Palestine
Συχάρ.as:
Συχάρ
(Ε, Σιχάρ), indecl., ἡ,
Sychar, a town of Samaria: Jo 4:5.†

συγχράομαι.sd: to use jointly, i.e. (by implication) to hold intercourse in common
συγχράομαι.as:
**† συν-χράομαι
(Rec. συγ-), -ῶμαι, [in Al.: I Ki 30:19 * ;]
to use together with. Metaph., c. dat. pers., to associate with: Jo 4:9 (Polyb., al.).†

συνεισέρχομαι.long: I enter together with, embark with.
συνεισέρχομαι.kj: go in with, go with into
συνεισέρχομαι.as:
συν-εισ-έρχομαι
[in LXX: Jb 22:4 (עִםבּוֹא), etc. ;]
to enter together: c. dat. pers., seq. εἰς, c. acc. loc., Jo 6:2218:15.†

συμμαθητής.der: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G3129 (μανθάνω);
συμμαθητής.as:
* συν-μαθητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ
a fellow-disciple: Jo 11:16 (on the use of συν- in such compounds as this, v. Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†

συνήθεια.der: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G2239 (ἦθος);
συνήθεια.as:
** συνήθεια, -ας, ἡ
(< ἦθος), [in LXX: IV Mac 2:126:1313:22, 27 * ;]
1intimacy.
2.habit, custom: Jo 18:39, I Co 11:16; c. gen. obj. (cf. Æschin., 23, 37, and v. MM, xxiv), habitual use, force of habit with respect to, I Co 8:7.†

σύρω.as:
σύρω
[in LXX: IV Ki 17:13 (סחב), IV Mac 6:1, al. ;]
to draw, drag: c. acc. rei, Jo 21:8, Re 12:4; c. acc. pers., of taking to trial or punish­ment, Ac 8:3; ἔξω τ. πόλεως, Ac 14:19; ἐπὶ τ. πολιτάρχας (cf. IV Mac, l.c.), Ac 17:6 (cf. κατα-σύρω).†

συναλίζομαι.as:
** συν-αλίζω
[in Al.: Ps 140 (141):4 * ;]
to assemble with: Ac 1:4 (EV, mg., eating with, but on this rendering and on the force of the pres. ptcp. here, v. Field, Notes, 110).†

συγκαταψηφίζομαι.g: I am voted or classed with
συγκαταψηφίζομαι.long: I am voted or classed with.
συγκαταψηφίζομαι.sd: to count down in company with, i.e. enroll among
συγκαταψηφίζομαι.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a compound of G2596 (κατά) and G5585 (ψηφίζω);
συγκαταψηφίζομαι.as:
*† συν-κατα-ψηφίζω (Rec. συγκ-),
1.to condemn with or together (Plut., Themist., 21).
2.to vote one a place among: pass., Ac 1:26. Not elsewhere .†

συγχέω.long: I bewilder, stir up, throw into confusion.
συγχέω.sd: to commingle promiscuously, i.e. (figuratively) to throw (an assembly) into disorder, to perplex (the mind)
συγχέω.kj: confound, confuse, stir up, be in an uproar
συγχέω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and (to pour) or its alternate;
συγχέω.as:
συν-χέω
(Rec. συγ-), [in LXX for בּלל, רגז, etc. ;]
to pour together, commingle, confuse; metaph., confound, throw into confusion, stir up trouble: Ac 21:27 (cf. συν-χύννω).†

σύνοιδα.g: to share the knowledge of, be privy to
σύνοιδα.as:
σύν-οιδα, pf. with Pres. meaning (v.s. οἶδα),
[in LXX: Le 5:1 (ידע), Jb 27:6; ptcp., I Mac 4:21 A, II Mac 4:41 A, III Mac 2:8 R * ;]
1.to share the knowledge of, be privy to (Hdt., Thuc., al.): ptcp., Ac 5:2.
2. C. pron. reflex., to be conscious of (Eur., Plat., al.), esp. of guilty consciousness: οὐδὲν γὰρ ἐμαυτῷ σ., for I know nothing against myself, I Co 4:4.†

συστέλλω.long: I contract, shorten, wrap around, swathe.
συστέλλω.sd: to send (draw) together, i.e. enwrap (enshroud a corpse for burial), contract (an interval)
συστέλλω.as:
συν-στέλλω
(Rec. συσ-), [in LXX: Jg 8:2811:33 (כּנע ni.), Si 4:31, al. ;]
1.to draw together, contract, shorten: of time, I Co 7:29.
2.to wrap up: of enshrouding a body for burial (Eur.), c. acc., Ac 5:6.†

συγκινέω.long: I move together, stir up, excite.
συγκινέω.sd: to move together, i.e. (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition)
συγκινέω.as:
* συν-κινέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to move together. Metaph., to excite, stir up: τ. λαόν, Ac 6:12 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†

Συχέμ.sd: Sychem (i.e. Shekem), the name of a Canaanite and of a place in Palestine
Συχέμ.as:
Συχέμ indecl. (Heb. שְׁכֶם),
Shechem;
1. the son of Hamor (Ge 33:19): Ac 7:16 b, Rec.
2. A city of Samaria (AV, Sychem; in LXX also sometimes Σίκιμα, -ων, as in FlJ): Ac 7:16 a,b.†

συγκομίζω.long: I bear away together with, as in carrying away a corpse.
συγκομίζω.sd: to convey together, i.e. collect or bear away in company with others
συγκομίζω.as:
συν-κομίζω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Jb 5:26 (עלה) * ;]
1.to bring together, collect (Hdt., Xen., al.).
2.to take up a body for burial (Soph., Aj., 1048): Ac 8:2 (v. Field, Notes, 116).†

σύνδεσμος.long: that which binds together; a band, bond.
σύνδεσμος.sd: a joint tie, i.e. ligament, (figuratively) uniting principle, control
σύνδεσμος.as:
σύν-δεσμος, -ου, ὁ
(< συνδέω), [in LXX for קשׁר, קטר, etc. ;]
that which binds together, a bond: of the ligaments of the body, Col 2:19. Metaph., σ. ἀδικίας, Ac 8:23; τ. τελειότητος, Col 3:14; τ. εἰρήνης, Eph 4:3 (v. Lft., Col., ll. c.).†

συνοδεύω.as:
† συν-οδεύω
[in LXX: Za 8:21א1 (הלך), To 5:16א, Wi 6:23 * ;]
to journey with: c. dat. pers., Ac 9:7 (Plut., al.).†

συμβιβάζω.long: (a) I unite or knit together, (b) I put together in reasoning, and so: I conclude, prove, (c) I teach, instruct.
συμβιβάζω.sd: causative (by reduplication) of the base of G939 (βάσις)); to drive together, i.e. unite (in association or affection), (mentally) to infer, show, teach
συμβιβάζω.kj: compact, assuredly gather, intrust, knit together, prove
συμβιβάζω.as:
συν-βιβάζω
(Rec. συμ-), [in LXX: Ex 4:12, 15, Le 10:11, Jg 13:8, Ps 31 (32):8 (ירה hi.); Ex 18:16, De 4:9, Is 40:13 (ידע hi.), ib. 14 (בּין hi.), Da TH 9:22 (שׂכל hi.) * ;]
1.to join or knit together, unite: Eph 4:16, Col 2:2 (but v. infr.), ib. 19.
2.to compare, consider, conclude (Plat.): Ac 16:10.
3.to deduce, prove, demonstrate (Arist.): Ac 9:22.
4. As in LXX ("translation Greek," = ἐμβιβάζω, metaph.), to teach, instruct: I Co 2:16, Ac 19:33, R, mg. (also in Vg., Col 2:2, instructi, but v. supr.).†

συνομιλέω.as:
* συν-ομιλέω, -ῶ
to converse with (absol., FlJ, BJ, v, 13, 1; seq. μετά, Cebes, 13): c. dat. pers., Ac 10:27.†

συμπίνω.sd: to partake a beverage in company
συμπίνω.as:
συμπόσιον, -ου, τό
(< συμπίνω), [in LXX: Es 7:7 (מִשְׁתֶּהיַיִן) 4:17, I Mac 16:16, II Mac 2:27, III Mac 4:165:366:33; σ. οἴνου, Sir 34 (31):3135 (32):5, 49:1 * ;]
1.a drinking party
2. By meton., of the party itself, the guests (Plut); pl., σ. σ. (colloq.; v. M, Pr., 97), in parties or companies: Mk 6:39.†

συναθροίζω.as:
συν-αθροίζω
[in LXX chiefly for קבץ ;]
to gather together, assemble: c. acc. pers., Ac 19:25; pass., Ac 12:12.†

συμπαραλαμβάνω.g: I take along as a companion
συμπαραλαμβάνω.long: I take along as a companion.
συμπαραλαμβάνω.as:
συν-παρα-λαμβάνω
(Rec. συμπ-), [in LXX: Ge 19:17 (ספה ni.), Jb 1:4 (שׁלח), III Mac 1:1 * ;]
to take along with: as a companion, c. acc., Ac 12:2515:37, 38 (on the tenses, v. M, Pr., 130), Ga 2:1.†

σύντροφος.long: one brought up with, a foster brother, an intimate friend.
σύντροφος.der: from G4862 (σύν) and G5162 (τροφός) (in a passive sense);
σύντροφος.as:
σύν-τροφος, -ου, ὁ
(< συντρέφομαι, to be brought up together) [in LXX: III Ki 12:24, I Mac 1:6 R, II Mac 9:29 * ;]
1. prop., one nourished or brought up with, a foster-brother: Ac 13:1 EV.
2. In Hellenistic usage, as a court term, an intimate friend of a king (v. Deiss., BS, 305, 310 f.): Ac 13:1 (cf. also MM, xxiv).†

συνεφίστημι.sd: to stand up together, i.e. to resist (or assault) jointly
συνεφίστημι.as:
* συν-εφ-ίστημι
to place over. Pass.,
1.to stand over (Thuc.).
2.to rise together: seq. κατά, c. gen. pers. (against), Ac 16:22.†

συνομορέω.long: I am contiguous with, am next door to.
συνομορέω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of a compound of the base of 3674 and the base of G3725 (ὅριον);
συνομορέω.as:
*† συν-ομορέω, -ῶ
to border on: c. dat., Ac 18:7 (Byz.).†

συμψηφίζω.long: I compute, reckon up, count together.
συμψηφίζω.as:
συμ-ψηφίζω
[in LXX: Je 29 (49):20 A * ;]
to reckon together, count up: Ac 19:19.†

σύγχυσις.as:
σύγχυσις, -εως, ἡ
(< συγχέω), [in LXX: Ge 11:9 (בָּבֶל), I Ki 5:6, 12 (11)14:20 (מְהוּמָה) * ;]
confusion: of a popular uproar, Ac 19:29.†

συνέκδημος.sd: a co-absentee from home, i.e. fellow-traveller
συνέκδημος.der: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G1553 (ἐκδημέω);
συνέκδημος.as:
*† συν-έκδημος, -ου, ὁ
(< ἔκδημος, abroad),
a fellow-traveller: Ac 19:29, II Co 8:19.†

συστροφή.long: a gathering together, riotous concourse, conspiracy.
συστροφή.sd: a twisting together, i.e. (figuratively) a secret coalition, riotous crowd
συστροφή.as:
συ-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< συστρέφω), [in LXX: Ho 4:1913:12 (צרר); σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Am 7:10 (קשׁר), etc. ;]
1.a twisting together (Plat.).
2.a concourse, a riotous gathering (Polyb.): Ac 19:40; σ. ποιεῖσθαι (Am, l.c.), to make a compact (RV, banded themselves together): Ac 23:12.†

συνέπομαι.der: middle voice from G4862 (σύν) and a primary (to follow);
συνέπομαι.as:
** συν-έπομαι
[in LXX: II Mac 15:2, III Mac 5:48 R 6:21 * ;]
to follow with, accompany: c. dat. pers., Ac 20:4.†

συμπεριλαμβάνω.sd: to take by enclosing altogether, i.e. earnestly throw the arms about one
συμπεριλαμβάνω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a compound of G4012 (περί) and G2983 (λαμβάνω);
συμπεριλαμβάνω.as:
συν-περι-λαμβάνω (Rec. συμπ-),
1.to enclose (Ez 5:3 (צוּר) *).
2.to embrace: c. acc. pers., Ac 20:10.†

συνθρύπτω.g: I break in pieces, crush, thoroughly weaken
συνθρύπτω.long: I break in pieces, crush, thoroughly weaken.
συνθρύπτω.sd: to crush together, i.e. (figuratively) to dispirit
συνθρύπτω.as:
*† συν-θρύπτω
to break in pieces, crush: metaph., τ. καρδίαν, Ac 21:13.†

συνδρομή.as:
** συνδρομή, -ῆς, ἡ
(< συντρέχω), [in LXX: Jth 10:18, III Mac 3:8 * ;]
a concourse, esp. of a riotous gathering: Ac 21:30 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†

συνείδησις.der: from a prolonged form of G4894 (συνείδω);
συνείδησις.as:
συν-είδησις, -εως, ἡ
(< συνεῖδον), [in LXX: Ec 10:20 (מַדָּע), Wi 17:11, Si 42:18א * ;]
1.consciousness: c. gen. obj., He 10:2, I Pe 2:19.
2. In ethical sense, innate discernment, self-judging consciousness, conscience (Stoics and late writers): Ro 2:159:1, I Co 10:29, II Co 1:124:25:11, I Ti 4:2, He 9:14; σ. ἀγαθή, Ac 23:1, I Ti 1:5, 19, I Pe 3:16, 21; ἀσθενής, I Co 8:7, 10; ἀσθενοῦσα, ib. 12; ἀπρόσκοπος, Ac 24:16; καθαρά, I Ti 3:9, II Ti 1:3; καλή, He 13:18; πονηρά, He 10:22; ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ σ., Tit 1:15; διὰ τὴν σ., Ro 13:5, I Co 10:25, 27, 28; κατὰ σ., He 9:9; ὑπὸ (τῆς) σ., Jo 8:[9] (Rec.), I Co 10:29 (cf. Cremer, 233 ff.; ICC on Ro 2:15; DB, i, 468 ff.).†

συνωμοσία.sd: a swearing together, i.e. (by implication) a plot
συνωμοσία.der: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G3660 (ὀμνύω);
συνωμοσία.as:
** συνωμοσία, -ας, ή
(συνόμνυμι, to conspire), [in Sm.: Ez 22:25 * ;]
a conspiracy: Ac 23:13.†

συγκαταβαίνω.as:
συν-κατα-βαίνω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Ps 48 (49):17 (ירד), Wi 10:13, Da LXX TH 3:49 * ;]
to go down with: Ac 25:5. In late writers also metaph. (Wis, l.c.), to condescend, on wh. v. Rutherford, NPhr., 485 f.†

συμπάρειμι.sd: to be at hand together, i.e. now present
συμπάρειμι.as:
συν-πάρειμι
(Rec. σνμπ-), [in LXX: To 12:12 ΑΒ, Pr 8:27 (?), Wi 9:10 * ;]
to be present together or with: c. dat. pers., Ac 25:24.†

Σύρτις.long: Syrtis, a quicksand off the coast of North Africa.
Σύρτις.sd: a shoal (from the sand drawn thither by the waves), i.e. the Syrtis Major or great bay on the north coast of Africa
Σύρτις.as:
Σύρτις (L, σῦρτις), -εως, acc. -ιν, ἡ,
Syrtis, the name of two large sand-banks on the Libyan coast: Ac 27:17.†

συμπαρακαλέομαι.g: I invite, encourage along with others
συμπαρακαλέομαι.long: I invite, encourage along with others; pass: I share in encouragement with.
συμπαρακαλέομαι.as:
* συν-παρα-καλέω (Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ,
to call upon or exhort together (Plat.). Pass., to be strengthened or comforted with and among: Ro 1:12.†

συμμαρτυρέω.sd: to testify jointly, i.e. corroborate by (concurrent) evidence
συμμαρτυρέω.as:
* συν-μαρτυρέω (Rec. συμμ-), -ῶ,
to bear witness with: Ro 2:15; c. dat., Ro 8:16; seq. ὅτι, Ro 9:1.†

σύντριμμα.sd: concussion or utter fracture (properly, concretely), i.e. complete ruin
σύντριμμα.as:
σύν-τριμμα, -τος, τό
(< συντρίβω), [in LXX (Le 21:19, al.) chiefly for שֶׁבֶר; also for שֹׁד (Is 59:7), etc. ;]
a fracture (Arist.; Le, l.c., al.). Metaph., calamity, destruction (Isa, l.c., Wi 3:3, al.): Ro 3:16(LXX).†

συνθάπτομαι.sd: to inter in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate spiritually (to Christ by a sepulture as to sin)
συνθάπτομαι.as:
* συν-θάπτω
to bury together with: in symbolical sense, of baptism, αὐτῷ (with Christ), Ro 6:4, Col 2:12.†

σύμφυτος.sd: grown along with (connate), i.e. (figuratively) closely united to
σύμφυτος.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G5453 (φύω);
σύμφυτος.as:
σύμ-φυτος, -ον
(< συμφύω, to make to grow together) [in LXX: Za 11:2 (בּצר), Es 7:7, 8א2, Am 9:13, III Mac 3:22 * ;]
1.congenital, innate (Plat., al.; III Mac, l.c.).
2.grown along with, united with: τ. ὁμοιώματι τ. θανάτου αὐτσῦ (v. Field, Notes, 155 f.), Ro 6:5.†

συζάω.sd: to continue to live in common with, i.e. co-survive (literally or figuratively)
συζάω.as:
* συν-ζάω (Rec. συζ-),
to live with: opp. to συναποθανεῖν, II Co 7:3; of life in union with Christ, here and hereafter, Ro 6:8, II Ti 2:11.†

σύμφημι.long: I assent to, consent, confess, agree with.
σύμφημι.sd: to say jointly, i.e. assent to
σύμφημι.as:
* σύν-φημι (Rec. συμ-),
to consent, confess: c. dat., seq. ὅτι, Ro 7:16.†

συνήδομαι.sd: to rejoice in with oneself, i.e. feel satisfaction concerning
συνήδομαι.der: middle voice from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G2237 (ἡδονή);
συνήδομαι.as:
* συν-ήδομαι
to rejoice together; c. dat., to rejoice with or in: τ. νόμῳ τ. θεοῦ, Ro 7:22 (v. Lft., Notes, 304).†

συγκληρονόμος.sd: a co-heir, i.e. (by analogy) participant in common
συγκληρονόμος.as:
*† συν-κληρο-νόμος (Rec. συγκ-), -ου, ὁ
a co-inheritor, fellow-heir: Ro 8:17, Eph 3:6; c. gen. rei, He 11:9, I Pe 3:7 (for exx., v. Deiss., LAE, 88 f.).†

συμπάσχω.sd: to experience pain jointly or of the same kind (specially, persecution; to "sympathize")
συμπάσχω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and G3958 (πάσχω) (including its alternate);
συμπάσχω.as:
** συν-πάσχω
(Rec. συμπ-), [in Al.: I Ki 22:8 * ;]
1.to suffer together or with: Ro 8:17, I Co 12:26.
2.to sympathize with (Plat., Arist.).†

συνδοξάζομαι.sd: to exalt to dignity in company (i.e. similarly) with
συνδοξάζομαι.as:
* συν-δοξάζω
1.to join in approving (Arist.).
2. In NT only, to glorify together: pass., Ro 8:17.†

συστενάζω.sd: to moan jointly, i.e. (figuratively) experience a common calamity
συστενάζω.as:
* συν-στενάζω (Rec. συσ-),
to groan together or with: Ro 8:22 (c. dat. pers., Eur., Ion., 935).†

συνωδίνω.sd: to have (parturition) pangs in company (concert, simultaneously) with, i.e. (figuratively) to sympathize (in expectation of relief from suffering)
συνωδίνω.as:
* συν-ωδίνω
to be in travail together (Arist.): metaph. (Eur.), Ro 8:22.†

σύμμορφος.as:
*† σύμ-μορφος, -ον
(< σύν, μορφή),
1. absol., similar (Luc.).
2.con­formed to: c. dat., Phl 3:21; c. gen., Ro 8:29 (v. B1., § 36, 11; 37, 6).†

συντέμνω.g: I cut short, bring to swift accomplishment
συντέμνω.long: I cut short, bring to swift accomplishment, determine, decide.
συντέμνω.sd: to contract by cutting, i.e. (figuratively) do concisely (speedily)
συντέμνω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G5114 (τομώτερος);
συντέμνω.as:
συν-τέμνω
[in LXX chiefly for חרץ ;]
1.to cut in pieces.
2.to cut down, cut short: metaph., λόγον, Ro 9:28(LXX) (Hdt., Plat., Eur., al.).†

συγκάμπτω.sd: to bend together, i.e. (figuratively) to afflict
συγκάμπτω.as:
συν-κάμπτω
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Ps 68:10, 23(מעדhi.), etc. ;]
to bend completely, bend together: τ. νῶτον, fig., Ro 11:10(LXX).†

συγκοινωνός.as:
*† συν-κοινωνός (Rec. συγκ-), όν,
partaking jointly of: c. gen. rei, Ro 11:17, I Co 9:23; id. c. gen. pers., Phl 1:7; seq. ἐν, Re 1:9.†

σύμβουλος.as:
σύμβουλος, -ου, ὁ
(< σύν, βουλή), [in LXX forיוֺעֵץand cogn. forms ;]
a counsellor, adviser: Ro 11:34(LXX).†

συσχηματίζομαι.sd: to fashion alike, i.e. conform to the same pattern (figuratively)
συσχηματίζομαι.kj: conform to, fashion self according to
συσχηματίζομαι.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G4976 (σχῆμα);
συσχηματίζομαι.as:
* συν-σχηματιζω (Rec. συσ-),
(< σχῆμα),
to conform to (Arist.). Pass., to be conformed to, conform oneself to: Ro 12:2, I Pe 1:14.†

συναπάγομαι.g: I lead away with, condescend to
συναπάγομαι.long: I lead away with, carry along with (in good or bad sense according to context); mid: I conform myself willingly to.
συναπάγομαι.sd: to take off together, i.e. transport with (seduce, passively, yield)
συναπάγομαι.as:
συν-απ-άγω
[in LXX: Ex 14:6 (לקח) * ;]
to lead away with or together (Ex, l.c.). Pass., metaph. (as συμπεριφέρομαι, v. LS, s.v.), to be carried away with: c. dat., Ga 2:13, II Pe 3:17; of accommodating one­self to (EV, condescend to) things or persons (on the meaning, v. ICC, in l.; Field, Notes, 163), Ro 12:16.†

συναγωνίζομαι.long: I struggle in company with, aid.
συναγωνίζομαι.sd: to struggle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to be a partner (assistant)
συναγωνίζομαι.as:
* συν-αγωνίζομαι
to strive together with, to help (prop., of sharing in a contest): c. dat. pers. et rei, Ro 15:30.†

συναναπαύομαι.sd: to recruit oneself in company with
συναναπαύομαι.as:
συν-ανα-παύομαι
[in LXX: Is 11:6 (רבץ) * ;]
c. dat. pers., to lie down to rest with, sleep with. Metaph., to be refreshed in spirit with: Ro 15:32 (L, om.).†

συνεργός.kj: companion in labour, (fellow-)helper(-labourer, -worker), labourer together with, workfellow
συνεργός.der: from a presumed compound of G4862 (σύν) and the base of G2041 (ἔργον);
συνεργός.as:
** συνεργός, -όν
[in LXX: II Mac 8:714:5 * ;]
a fellow-worker: c. gen. pers., Ro 16:3, 9, 21, Phl 2:254:3, I Th 3:2, Rec., Phm 1, 24; θεοῦ (cf. Lft., Notes, 41, 188), I Co 3:9 (pl.), I Th 3:2 [WH] R, mg. (R, txt., διάκονον τοῦ θ.; on the original reading, v. ICC, in l.); τ. χαρᾶς ὑηῶν, II Co 1:24; τ. ἀληθείᾳ, III Jo 8; seq. εἰς, II Co 8:23, Col 4:11.†

συναιχμάλωτος.as:
*† συν-αιχμάλωτος, -ου, ὁ
a fellow prisoner (prop., of a captive in war, v. Lft., Col., 234): Ro 16:7, Col 4:10, Phm 23.†

συζητητής.long: a disputer, as the Greek sophists.
συζητητής.as:
*† συν-ζητητής (Rec. συζ-), -οῦ, ἁ
(< συνζητέω),
a disputer, disputant: I Co 1:20.†

συγκρίνω.long: I join together, combine, compare, interpret, explain.
συγκρίνω.sd: to judge of one thing in connection with another, i.e. combine (spiritual ideas with appropriate expressions) or collate (one person with another by way of contrast or resemblance)
συγκρίνω.as:
συν-κρίνω
(Rec. συγκ-) [in LXX chiefly for פּתר ;]
1.to compound, combine: I Co 2:13, R, mg.1 (Lft., Notes, 180 f.).
2. In Arist. and later writers (Wi 7:29, al.) = παραβάλλω, to compare: I Co, l.c., R, txt. (Field, Notes, 168), II Co 10:12
3. In LXX, of dreams, to interpret (Ge 40:8, I Co, l.c., R, mg.2 (but v. reff. supr.).†

συμβασιλεύω.as:
συμ-βουλεύω
[in LXX chiefly for יעץ ;]
1.to advise, counsel: c. dat. pers., Jo 18:14; id. seq. inf., Re 3:18.
2. Mid., to take counsel, consult: seq. ἵνα, Mt 26:4 ("reciprocal middle," v. M, Pr., 157); c. inf., Ac 9:23.†

συναναμίγνυμι.long: I mingle together with, keep company with.
συναναμίγνυμι.sd: to mix up together, i.e. (figurative) associate with
συναναμίγνυμι.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a compound of G303 (ἀνά) and G3396 (μίγνυμι);
συναναμίγνυμι.as:
* συν-ανα-μίγνυμι
(acc to Bl., 8, -μείγνυμι), [in LXX: Ho 7:8 A (בּלל hithpo.), Ez 20:18 A * ;]
to mix up together; pass., reflex, and metaph., to associate with (Plut., Ath., al.): I Co 5:9, 11, II Th 3:14 (v. M, Th., 117).†

σύμφωνος.sd: sounding together (alike), i.e. (figuratively) accordant (neuter as noun, agreement)
σύμφωνος.as:
σύμφωνος, -ον
(< σύν, φωνή), [in LXX: Ec 7:15 (14) (לְעֻמַּת), IV Mac 7:714:7 * ;]
agreeing in sound. Metaph., harmonious, agreeing: ἐκ συμφώνου (for exx. from π., v. Deiss., BS, 255), by agreement, I Co 7:5.†

συγγνώμη.der: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G1097 (γινώσκω);

σύμφορον.long: I bring together, collect; I am profitable to.
σύμφορον.sd: to bear together (contribute), i.e. (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage
σύμφορον.kj: be better for, bring together, be expedient (for), be good, (be) profit(-able for)
σύμφορον.der: from G4862 (σύν) and G5342 (φέρω) (including its alternate);
σύμφορον.as:
συμ-φέρω
[in LXX: Je 33 (26):14 (טוֹב), Pr 19:10 (נָאוֶה), Si 30:19, al. ;]
1. trans. to bring together: c. acc. rei, Ac 19:19.
2. Intrans., and mostly impers., συμφέρει, it is expedient, profitable or an advantage: I Co 6:1210:23, II Co 8:10; c. inf. (M, Pr., 210), Mt 19:10, Jo 18:14; c. dat., seq. ἵνα (Bl., § 69, 5), Mt 5:29, 3018:6, Jo 11:5016:7. Ptcp., ςυμφέρων, profitable: I Co 12:7; pl., Ac 20:20; (οὐ σ. sc. ἐστιν; = οὐ συμφέρει; cf. Thuc., iii, 44, 2), II Co 12:1; as subst., τὸ σ., profit, He 12:10.†

συμμερίζομαι.long: I partake with, divide together with, have a share in.
συμμερίζομαι.sd: to share jointly, i.e. participate in
συμμερίζομαι.der: middle voice from G4862 (σύν) and G3307 (μερίζω);
συμμερίζομαι.as:
† συν-μερίζω
(Rec. συμμ-), [in LXX: Pr 29:24א2 (חלק) * ;]
to distri­bute in shares. Mid., to have a share in: I Co 9:13 (Diod., al.).†

συγκεράννυμι.sd: to commingle, i.e. (figuratively) to combine or assimilate
συγκεράννυμι.as:
συν-κεράννυμι
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Da LXX 2:43 (עֲרַב ithpa.), II Mac 15:39 * ;]
to mix or blend together, compound: c. acc., I Co 12:24; ptcp. pf. pass., He 4:2, T, WH, mg., R, mg.; id., of persons, c. dat. instr., to be united with, agree with, ib., WH, txt., R, txt. (v. Westc., in l.).†

συνυπουργέω.long: I help together, join in serving.
συνυπουργέω.sd: to be a co-auxiliary, i.e. assist
συνυπουργέω.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of a compound of G5259 (ὑπό) and the base of G2041 (ἔργον);
συνυπουργέω.as:
* συν-υπουργέω, -ῶ
to help together, join in serving: c. dat. instr., II Co 1:11.†

συστατικός.as:
* συ-στατικός (Tr. συν-), -ή, -όν
(< συνίστημι),
1.for putting together, constructive.
2.for bringing together, introductory, commendatory: ἐπιστολή (Arist., Diog. L., al.; and v. MM, xxiv), II Co 3:1.†

συμφώνησις.as:
*† συμ-φώνησις, -εως, ἡ
(< συμφωνέω),
concord, agreement: seq. πρός, c. acc. pers., II Co 6:15.†

συγκατάθεσις.sd: a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) accord with
συγκατάθεσις.as:
*† συν-κατά-θεσις (Rec συγκ-), -εως, ἡ
(< συνκατατίθημι)
concord, agreement: II Co 6:16 (Polyb., Plut., al.).†

συμπέμπω.as:
* συν-πέμπω (Rec. συμπ-)
to send together with: c. acc. et dat., II Co 8:22; id. seq. μετά, c. gen., ib. 18.†

συλάω.sd: probably akin to G138 (αἱρέομαι); compare G4661 (σκῦλον)); to despoil
συλάω.as:
** συλάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Ep. Je 1:18 * ;]
c. acc. pers., to strip, plunder, spoil: II Co 11:8.†

συναποστέλλω.sd: to despatch (on an errand) in company with
συναποστέλλω.as:
συν-απο-στέλλω
[in LXX: Ex 33:2, 12 (שׁלח), I Es 5:2 * ;]
to send along with: c. acc., II Co 12:18 (cf. MM, xxiv).†

συνηλικιώτης.sd: a co-aged person, i.e. alike in years
συνηλικιώτης.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G2244 (ἡλικία);
συνηλικιώτης.as:
*† συν-ηλικιώτης
(< ἡλικία), = συνῆλιζ (Æsch.),
one of the same age, an equal in age: Ga 1:14.†

συνυποκρίνομαι.long: I dissemble with, play a part with.
συνυποκρίνομαι.sd: to act hypocritically in concert with
συνυποκρίνομαι.as:
*† συν-υπο-κρίνομαι
to play a part with, dissemble with: c. dat., Ga 2:13 (Polyb.).†

συναπάγω.g: I lead away with, condescend to
συναπάγω.long: I lead away with, carry along with (in good or bad sense according to context); mid: I conform myself willingly to.
συναπάγω.sd: to take off together, i.e. transport with (seduce, passively, yield)
συναπάγω.as:
συν-απ-άγω
[in LXX: Ex 14:6 (לקח) * ;]
to lead away with or together (Ex, l.c.). Pass., metaph. (as συμπεριφέρομαι, v. LS, s.v.), to be carried away with: c. dat., Ga 2:13, II Pe 3:17; of accommodating one­self to (EV, condescend to) things or persons (on the meaning, v. ICC, in l.; Field, Notes, 163), Ro 12:16.†

συνιστάνω.g: to commend; to demonstrate; to hold together

συστοιχέω.long: I am in the same rank with; I answer to, correspond to.
συστοιχέω.sd: to file together (as soldiers in ranks), i.e. (figuratively) to correspond to
συστοιχέω.as:
*† συν-στοιχέω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ,
to stand in the same rank or line (Polyb). Metaph., to correspond to: Ga 4:25 (v. Lft., in l.).†

συζωοποιέω.as:
*† συν-ζωο-ποιέω (Rec. συζ-), ῶ-,
to make alive or quicken together with; metaph., of the spiritual life: τ. Χριστῷ, Eph 2:5; σὺν τ. Χ., Col 2:13.†

συνεγείρω.sd: to rouse (from death) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to revivify (spirtually) in resemblance to
συνεγείρω.as:
συν-εγείρω
[in LXX: Ex 23:5 B2 (עזב), Is 14:9 (עוּר pil.), IV Mac 2:14 * ;]
to raise together: metaph., of the Christian's mystical resur­rection with Christ, Eph 2:6; pass., Col 2:123:1.†

συμπολίτης.sd: a native of the same town, i.e. (figuratively) co-religionist (fellow-Christian)
συμπολίτης.as:
* συν-πολίτης (Rec. σνμπ-), -ου, ὁ
a fellow-citizen: pl., σ. τ. ἁγίων, opp. to ξένοι κ. πάροικοι, Eph 2:19 (Eur.; C.I., 6446; condemned by Atticists; v. Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.).†

συναρμολογέομαι.sd: to render close-jointed together, i.e. organize compactly
συναρμολογέομαι.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of a compound of G719 (ἁρμός) and G3004 (λέγω) (in its original sense of laying);
συναρμολογέομαι.as:
*† συν-αρμολογέω, -ῶ
(< ἁρμός, λέγω), = cl. συναρμόζω,
to fit or frame together: of the parts of a building, Eph 2:21; of the members of the body, Eph 4:16 (Eccl.).†

συνοικοδομέω.sd: to construct, i.e. (passively) to compose (in company with other Christians, figuratively)
συνοικοδομέω.as:
** συν-οικοδομέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: I Es 5:68 * ;]
1.to build together or with (c. dat. pers., I Es, l.c.).
2. Of various materials, to build up together (Thuc., al.): metaph., of Christians, Eph 2:22.†

σύσσωμος.long: belonging to the same body; fig: of Jews and Gentiles belonging to the same Church.
σύσσωμος.sd: of a joint body, i.e. (figuratively) a fellow-member of the Christian community
σύσσωμος.as:
*† σύν-σωμος (Rec. συσσ-), -ον
(< σῶμα),
of the same body: Eph 3:6 (Eccl.).†

συμμέτοχος.as:
* συν-μέτοχος (Rec. συμμ-), -ον,
partaking together with; as subst., ὁ σ., a joint partaker (c. dat. pers. et gen. rei, FlJ, BJ, i, 24, 6): c. gen. rei, Eph 3:6; c. gen. pers., ib. 5:7 (Arist.).†

συγκοινωνέω.long: I am a partaker with, have fellowship with, am an accomplice in.
συγκοινωνέω.sd: to share in company with, i.e. co-participate in
συγκοινωνέω.kj: communicate (have fellowship) with, be partaker of
συγκοινωνέω.as:
* συν-κοινωνέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to have fellowship with or in (in cl., c. gen. rei, dat. pers.): c. dat. rei, Eph 5:11, Re 18:4; id. c. gen. pers., Phl 4:14.†

συναθλέω.long: I compete together with others, cooperate vigorously with.
συναθλέω.sd: to wrestle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to seek jointly
συναθλέω.as:
* συν-αθλέω, -ῶ
= συναγωνίζομαι: c. dat. commod., Phl 1:27; c. dat. pers., seq. ἐν, Phl 4:3.†

σύμψυχος.as:
*† σύν-ψυχος (Rec. συμ-), -ον
(< ψυχή),
of one mind: Phl 2:2.†

συστρατιώτης.long: a fellow soldier (in the Christian faith).
συστρατιώτης.sd: a co-campaigner, i.e. (figuratively) an associate in Christian toil
συστρατιώτης.as:
* συν-στρατιώτης (Rec. συσ-), -ου, ὁ
a fellow-soldier (Plat., Xen., al.). Metaph., of fellowship in Christian service: Phl 2:25, Phm 2 .†

συμμορφίζομαι.as:
*† συμ-μορφίζω (T, συν-),
(< σύμμορφος),
to conform to: pass. ptcp., Phl 3:10 (v. Lft., Phl., 128).†

συμμιμητής.der: from a presumed compound of G4862 (σύν) and G3401 (μιμέομαι);
συμμιμητής.as:
*† συν-μιμητής (Rec. συμμ-), -οῦ, ὁ
a fellow-imitator: c. gen. obj., Phl 3:17 (v. ICC, in l.). Not elsewhere.†

Συντύχη.long: Syntyche, a woman member of the church at Philippi.
Συντύχη.sd: an accident; Syntyche, a Christian female

σύζυγος.sd: co-yoked, i.e. (figuratively) as noun, a colleague; probably rather as a proper name; Syzygus, a Christian
σύζυγος.as:
** σύν-ζυγος (Rec. ουζ-), or as WH, mg., Σύνζυγος, -ον
(< συνζεύγνυμι), [in Aq., Ez 23:21 * ;]
a yoke fellow. Prob., as proper name, Σ. γνήσιε, genuinely Synzygus, S. properly so-called, Phl 4:3 (v. ICC, Lft., in l.; MM, xxiii).†

συλαγωγέω.long: I plunder, lead captive; met: I make victim by fraud.
συλαγωγέω.sd: to lead away as booty, i.e. (figuratively) seduce
συλαγωγέω.der: from the base of G4813 (συλάω) and (the reduplicated form of) G71 (ἄγω);
συλαγωγέω.as:
*† συλαγωγέω, -ῶ
(< σύλη, booty + ἄγω),
to carry off as spoil, lead captive (θυγατέρα, Heliod., Aeth., 10, 35): metaph., Col 2:8.†

συμφυλέτης.long: one of the same tribe, a fellow country-man.
συμφυλέτης.sd: a co-tribesman, i.e. native of the same country
συμφυλέτης.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of G5443 (φυλή);
συμφυλέτης.as:
*† συμ-φυλέτης, -ου, ὁ
(< σύν, φυλή; cf. σύμφυλος, Aq.: Za 13:7; and v. Rutherford, NPhr., 255 f.)
a fellow-tribesman, fellow-countryman: I Th 2:14 (v. M, Th., in l., and Intr. liii). Not found elsewhere.†

συγκακοπαθέω.sd: to suffer hardship in company with
συγκακοπαθέω.as:
*† συν-κακοπαθέω (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment: II Ti 2:3; c. dat. commod., τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, ib. 1:18.†

συνεπιμαρτυρέω.long: I unite in bearing witness, sanction.
συνεπιμαρτυρέω.sd: to testify further jointly, i.e. unite in adding evidence
συνεπιμαρτυρέω.as:
* συν-επι-μαρτυρέω, -ῶ
to join in attesting, bear witness together with: He 2:4 (Arist., Polyb., al.).†

συμπαθέω.g: I sympathize with, have compassion on
συμπαθέω.long: I sympathize with, have compassion on.
συμπαθέω.sd: to feel "sympathy" with, i.e. (by implication) to commiserate
συμπαθέω.kj: have compassion, be touched with a feeling of
συμπαθέω.as:
** συν-παθέω
(Rec. συμπ-), -ῶ, [in LXX: IV Mac 5:25 AR 13:23 * ;]
to have a fellow feeling for or with, sympathize with or in: c. dat. rei, He 4:15; dat. pers., ib. 10:34 (Arist., Plut., al.).†

συγκακουχέομαι.sd: to maltreat in company with, i.e. (passively) endure persecution together
συγκακουχέομαι.as:
*† συν-κακουχέομαι (Rec. συγκ-), -οῦμαι, pass.
to endure adversity with: c. dat. pers., He 11:25. Not elsewhere.†

συναπόλλυμαι.sd: to destroy (middle voice or passively, be slain) in company with
συναπόλλυμαι.as:
συν-απ-όλλυμι
[in LXX chiefly forספה;]
to destroy with or together. Pass., to perish together (with): c. dat. pers., He 11:31.†

συνδέομαι.long: I bind together; pass: I am bound together with, as of prisoners in chains.
συνδέομαι.sd: to bind with, i.e. (passively) be a fellow-prisoner (figuratively)
συνδέομαι.as:
συν-δέω
[in LXX for שׁבץ, etc. ;]
(a)to bind together;
(b)to bind together with: pass., He 13:3.†

συνοικέω.g: I dwell with, live in wedlock with
συνοικέω.long: I dwell with, live in wedlock with.
συνοικέω.as:
συν-οικέω, -ῶ
[in LXX for בּעל etc. ;]
to dwell together: of man and wife (Hdt., al.), c. dat. pers., I Pe 3:7,†

συμπαθής.sd: having a fellow-feeling ("sympathetic"), i.e. (by implication) mutually commiserative
συμπαθής.as:
συμπαθής, -ές
(< σύν, πάσχω) [in LXX: Jb 29:25 A (אֹבֵל), IV Mac 5:25א, 13:2315:4 * ;]
1.affected by like feelings, sympathetic: I Pe 3:8.
2.exciting sympathy (Jb, l.c.; Dion. H.).†

συνεκλεκτός.sd: chosen in company with, i.e. co-elect (fellow Christian)
συνεκλεκτός.der: from a compound of G4862 (σύν) and G1586 (ἐκλέγομαι);
συνεκλεκτός.as:
*† συν-εκ-λεκτός, -ή, -όν
chosen together with, co-elect: ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτή (on the meaning, v. ICC, in l.), I Pe 5:13.†

συνευωχέομαι.sd: to entertain sumptuously in company with, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to revel together
συνευωχέομαι.der: from G4862 (σύν) and a derivative of a presumed compound of G2095 (εὖ) and a derivative of G2192 (ἔχω) (meaning to be in good condition, i.e. (by implication) to fare well, or feast);
συνευωχέομαι.as:
* συν-ευωχέω, -ῶ
to entertain together. Pass., to fare sumptuously or feast together or with: Ju 12; c. dat. pers., II Pe 2:13 (Arist., Luc., al.).†
